summary: This self-paced lesson covers HTTP GET and POST methods as well as 2xx, 4xx, and 5xx response status categories. It features clear concept explanations, worked examples, practice scenarios, external video links, and multiple-choice questions. Rubric average 4.8/5. Measured time 28.8 of 45 min. Reviewer: gemini-3.5-flash-lite.

rubric.justification: The language is precise, highly accessible to adult beginners, and avoids unnecessary complexity.
Logical progression from basic definitions to methods, status codes, examples, and practice.
Most terms like idempotent and safe are defined well, though brief introductory glosses could be sharper.
Real-world scenarios like weather fetching and sign-up forms make abstract concepts concrete.
Directly applies to web browsing, API interactions, and debugging common web errors.
Every outcome is directly supported by explanations, examples, practice tasks, and quiz questions.
